key_catalyst: Nvidia's reported $250B OpenAI financing backstop reviving AI circular-financing fears
reasoning: The WSJ report of Nvidia's ~$250B OpenAI backstop is a novel, high-severity catalyst that attacks the demand side of the AI trade (suppliers financing their own customers), compounding the existing capex-ROI scrutiny that already drove sustained multi-day selling after Alphabet/Tesla on 2026-07-23 and 2026-07-24. Simultaneously, Fed tightening expectations are escalating fast — from a 30% surprise-hike probability on 2026-07-27 to >70% odds of a 2026 hike with a September quarter-point hike now priced in — directly pressuring the long-duration megacaps that dominate QQQ. With the Fed decision Wednesday and MSFT/META/AAPL/AMZN reporting into a high bar, the catalyst stack is unresolved and worsening rather than absorbed.
